## Overview

Explore HTC U Ultra: source-listed display, performance, battery and camera details, followed by practical checks before making a decision. This is a reference guide, not a new-launch report.

## Source-listed specifications

| Field | Source-listed detail |
| --- | --- |
| Manufacturer | HTC |
| Display | 5.7 inch Super LCD5 capacitive touchscreen with Corning Gorilla Glass 5 for the 64 GB model and Sapphire crystal glass for the 128 GB model. 1440 × 2560 pixels (~513 ppi pixel density) |
| Processor | Quad-core (2x2.15 GHz Kryo & 2x1.6 GHz Kryo) |
| Battery | Non-removable Li-Ion 3000 mAh battery |
| Ram | 4 GB RAM |
| Storage | 64 or 128 GB |
| Cameras | 12 MP, f/1.8, 26mm, OIS, laser & phase detection autofocus, dual-LED (dual tone) flash 1/2.3 in. sensor size, 1.55μm pixel size, geo-tagging, touch focus, face detection, Auto-HDR, panorama |
| Connectivity | Wi-Fi : 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, DLNA, hotspot Bluetooth : v4.2, A2DP, LE GPS : Yes, with A-GPS, GLONASS, BDS NFC : Yes USB : v3.1, Type-C 1.0 reversible connector |
| Os | Android "Nougat" 7.0 ; Android "Oreo" 8.0 with HTC Sense 8.0 ; Unofficial: Android 12 via LineageOS |
| Front Camera | 16 MP, 1080p, Auto-HDR |
| Weight | 170 g (6.0 oz) |
| Dimensions | dimensions: 162.4 mm (6.39 in) H 79.8 mm (3.14 in) W 8 mm (0.31 in) D |
| Removable storage | MicroSD up to 2TB |
| External display | 160 × 1040 pixels, 2.05 inches |

## How to compare specifications

Check the exact regional model, chipset, screen, battery capacity, charging standards, camera hardware, storage, network bands and promised software updates against manufacturer documentation.

## Price and availability

Prices vary by market, storage option, taxes and date. Confirm the live selling price, warranty, launch status and availability with the manufacturer or authorized retailer.

## Buyer checklist

Check regional warranty, supported networks, return policy, update commitments, accessories and repair availability before purchase.

## Verification and limitations

This profile is based on a source directory record. An empty field means the information was not verified, not that a feature or course is unavailable. Figures and specifications may change by country, variant and date. Always confirm on the [source page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTC_U_Ultra) before applying or buying. Published as a reference guide on 2026-11-12, not as breaking news.

## जरूरी जाँच

निर्माता के दस्तावेजों से सही क्षेत्रीय मॉडल, चिपसेट, स्क्रीन, बैटरी, चार्जिंग, कैमरा, स्टोरेज, नेटवर्क बैंड और सॉफ्टवेयर अपडेट की जानकारी मिलाएँ।

कीमत बाजार, स्टोरेज, टैक्स और तारीख के अनुसार बदलती है। मौजूदा कीमत, वारंटी और उपलब्धता निर्माता या अधिकृत विक्रेता से जाँचें।

खरीदने से पहले स्थानीय वारंटी, नेटवर्क सपोर्ट, वापसी नीति, अपडेट, एक्सेसरीज और मरम्मत की उपलब्धता जाँचें।

## सत्यापन

आवेदन या खरीद से पहले [आधिकारिक या संदर्भ स्रोत](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTC_U_Ultra) पर फीस, कीमत, मॉडल, पात्रता और उपलब्धता जाँचें। बिना सत्यापन के कोई नया दावा नहीं किया गया है।
